description: Photovoltaic power and weather parameters is a data set deposited in IEEE DataPort by its authors Sonia Leva, Alfredo Nespoli (Politecnico di Milano). This dataset includes PV power production measured on the SolarTech Lab, Politecnico di Milano, Italy. Data are freely available for scientific research purpose and further data validation.In particular, the dataset is composed of the following variables and specifics, with a time resolution of 1 minute:Timestamp: column with time recordings; the data format is “dd-MM-yyyy hh:mm:ss” ... Coverage: national (IT); the metadata date the deposit to 2020. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge, and IEEE DataPort normally asks for a free account before download (not tested). The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-ieeedp-repository.
